review_kind: Author mathematical strengthening and simplification audit; independent review is separately recorded in this review directory.
strengthenings: Disjoint diagonal mismatch and crossing-core images improve the cut factor from 4 to 2, hence the recovery coefficient from eta/(8(D+1)^2) to eta/(4(D+1)^2).
Sharp endpoints allow 0<=eta<=2, while all original eta<=1 theorem signatures are preserved.
The conditional helper endpoint allows an arbitrary finite joint law of source X and helper Z, charges P-H(X|Z), and averages branch-dependent real state budgets.
The reachable-range endpoint permits arbitrary ambient state types, with each branch range bounded by 2^{s(a)}; its conclusion is cP-(P-H_bits(X|Z))<=E[s(Z)].
scope: Actual bipartite shear incidence L with row and column support bounded by D and actual vertex expansion.
Both selected row sets have cardinality m, independently on raw/stored sides; branch-selected recodings are separate bijections within each row.
Both complementary recovery states must decode the selected raw half from the corresponding stored half and their state; the common branch budget may differ between helper values.
Correctness is required on the finite sample fibers, including zero-weight samples; zero-probability helper branches contribute zero average weight.
This is a local-recovery obstruction for a known cheap encoder, not a normalization theorem or an unrestricted multiplication/transposition lower bound.
reuse: The original core-cross cardinality bound is a corollary of the disjoint joint count.
Generic diagonal image containment is shared between standalone mismatch count and the joint count.
Original cut/rank/recovery theorems are direct corollaries of the stronger chain.
The reachable-state restriction is constructed once; the original range endpoint follows from the new endpoint and the shared entropy-charge comparison.

independent_review.scope: Complete four modules and rank/entropy dependencies; exact original headers and source hashes; focused independent axiom checks.
